title: Review launches' pushInsteadOf rewrite breaks three supervise_test fixtures that push to temp repos
body: Under a review-epic launch's GIT_CONFIG_* env (url.ticfac-read-only-grade://...pushInsteadOf='/' and friends), internal/reconcile's TestAStopThatNeedsAPersonStillStopsUnderSupervision, TestAResumableRefusalIsContinuedByTheRunAndCountedAsAnIntervention and TestTheSameRefusalOverAnUnchangedTreeHaltsInsteadOfSpinning fail with 'remote-ticfac-read-only-grade is not a git command', because the fixtures' pushes to local temp origins are rewritten too. They pass with the env stripped. A read-only reviewer therefore cannot run the suite the gate runs; fixtures should scrub the inherited GIT_CONFIG_* push keys the way they pin maintenance.auto.
